parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 measurements for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) that have a canonical SMILES string and a PubMed ID or DOI. Use the join path molecule_dictionary -> compound_structures -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary, with LEFT JOIN compound_records for compound_key and LEFT JOIN docs for pubmed_id_or_doi. Filter by target CHEMBL5251, standard_type = 'IC50', and require canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL and (pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR doi IS NOT NULL). Return all requested columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
